big_case.notes: The question (whether post-Mallory consent-by-registration jurisdiction requires express statutory notice, and whether later judicial construction can supply it) matters to every multistate corporation, and it drew a call for a response and one amicus. But the case itself is a private $10.9M default-judgment set-aside dispute from an unpublished Georgia intermediate-court decision, with a contested preservation record and a forum-resident plaintiff; it was denied without a noted dissent or statement. Mid-low stakes as a vehicle.
